title: MDiabetes
description: A unique and fully configurable plugin that simulates diabetes in Minecraft with custom recipes, realistic mechanics, and immersive gameplay systems.
body:
# MDiabetes

MDiabetes adds a realistic and immersive diabetes simulation system to Minecraft!

This unique plugin introduces diabetes mechanics, blood sugar management, custom recipes, and gameplay effects that create a completely new survival experience.

Perfect for roleplay servers, SMPs, realistic survival gameplay, educational projects, or unique challenge servers.

## Features

* Realistic diabetes simulation
* Blood sugar management system
* Custom food recipes
* Gameplay effects based on sugar levels
* Fully configurable
* Performance optimized
* No watermarks
* Modern and immersive systems
* Adjustable messages and settings
* Stable and efficient code

## Gameplay

Players must manage their diabetes by:

* monitoring sugar levels
* consuming the right foods
* crafting custom items and recipes
* avoiding dangerous effects caused by low or high sugar levels

The system creates a realistic and challenging survival experience.

## Included Systems

### Diabetes System

Advanced mechanics simulating blood sugar and diabetes effects.

### Custom Recipes

Craft special foods and items designed for the diabetes system.

### Survival Mechanics

Players must carefully balance food consumption and survival.

### Effects & Consequences

Incorrect management can lead to negative potion effects and gameplay disadvantages.

## Why Choose MDiabetis?

* Unique gameplay experience
* Adds realistic survival mechanics
* Perfect for roleplay and SMPs
* Highly immersive systems
* Lightweight and optimized
* Designed for modern Minecraft versions

## Use Cases

* Realistic SMPs
* Survival Challenges
* Educational Projects
* Roleplay Servers
* Community Events
* Hardcore Survival
